note: Europe at the end of 1918 after the Armistice: the German and Austro-Hungarian empires have collapsed, Poland and several successor states have emerged, and borders remain provisional or contested. Modern administrative regions are approximate territorial proxies.

properties.label: Austria
properties.info: The Republic of German-Austria was proclaimed in November 1918 after the dissolution of Austria-Hungary. Its borders were provisional.

properties.label: Hungary
properties.info: Hungary declared itself a republic in November 1918. Its postwar borders had not yet been settled.

properties.label: Czechoslovakia
properties.info: Czechoslovakia declared independence in October 1918, joining the Czech lands and Slovakia. Borders were provisional.

properties.realm: Kingdom of Serbs, Croats and Slovenes
properties.label: Yugoslavia
properties.info: The Kingdom of Serbs, Croats and Slovenes was proclaimed in December 1918, uniting Serbia, Montenegro and South Slavic lands of the former Austria-Hungary. Borders were provisional.

properties.label: Poland
properties.info: Poland was restored as an independent state in November 1918. Its borders remained disputed and provisional.

properties.label: Romania
properties.info: Romania claimed Transylvania and united with Bessarabia in 1918; these borders were not yet internationally settled.
Italian forces occupied Trentino, South Tyrol, Gorizia and Trieste in November 1918; formal borders were settled later.
France resumed control of Alsace-Lorraine after the German armistice in November 1918.

properties.label: Finland
properties.info: Finland declared independence from Russia in December 1917. The proposed Finnish king abdicated in December 1918, leaving Mannerheim as regent.

properties.label: Estonia
properties.info: Estonia had declared independence in February 1918, although foreign troops and the ensuing War of Independence made control contested.

properties.label: Latvia
properties.info: Latvia declared independence in November 1918. German forces and the ongoing War of Independence made control contested.

properties.label: Lithuania
properties.info: Lithuania declared independence in February 1918; German occupation and subsequent fighting left control contested.

properties.label: Ukraine
properties.info: The Ukrainian People's Republic was restored in December 1918 after the Hetmanate fell. Its territory was contested in the civil war.

properties.label: Georgia
properties.info: Georgia declared independence in May 1918 after the collapse of the Russian Empire.

properties.label: Armenia
properties.info: The First Republic of Armenia declared independence in May 1918 amid war and disputed borders.

properties.label: Azerbaijan
properties.info: The Azerbaijan Democratic Republic declared independence in May 1918; its borders remained contested.
